C0714.title: World's First AIGC Platform Copyright Infringement Case (Ultraman Case)
C0714.summary: In 2024, the Guangzhou Internet Court ruled that an AI platform infringed the plaintiff's reproduction and adaptation rights to the Ultraman works while providing AIGC services. The court found the platform liable for generating infringing content, marking the first global copyright infringement ruling against an AIGC platform.
